scope: local report generator only; production application and SQL sampler not changed
cause: update-status.cjs synchronously materialized the whole JSONL as a JavaScript string before split and parse; size exceeded Node string limit
fix: stream each JSONL line in Python, aggregate count and CPU/memory extrema without materializing the whole file, reject malformed complete records and flag an incomplete trailing record
note: watchdog readiness/healthy referred to sampler and production; it did not prove the report publication was fresh. Historical report staleness is a monitoring defect, not a student generation failure.
